descriptions.text: The DeFi protocol Neutrl announced on platform X that its frontend appears to have been compromised and that the team is conducting an urgent investigation. On 18 March 2026, Neutrl’s web frontend was compromised via DNS hijack, redirecting visitors to a fake site. Some users may have risked malicious approvals, but no direct protocol or user fund loss has been confirmed. Neutrl paused contracts, migrated to a new domain, and resumed safely. Neutrl’s DNS records were hijacked, allowing attackers to redirect the project’s official domain to a malicious server presenting a phishing frontend. This put users interacting with the site at risk, but did not directly affect on-chain contracts or assets.
